{{Quote|I think I've found a new safe heaven, Princess! It's a planet in the Drexel system....|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 11">[[Star Wars (1977) 11|''Star Wars'' (1977) 11]]</ref>}}
The '''Drexel system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Lol sector/Legends|Lol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the lone [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Drexel/Legends|Drexel]].<ref name="SW15SD" />

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Drexel system was the theater of a [[Battle of the Drexel system|battle]] concluded with a Republic victory.<ref name="TOR" />

The system was the location of a battle between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and the space pirates led by [[Quarg]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]] confirmed that the [[Drexel Minor system/Legends|Drexel Minor system]] was created because the Drexel system from [[Star Wars (1977)|Marvel Star Wars]] has only one planet, [[Drexel/Legends|Drexel]], and can't also contain [[Drexel II]].<ref name="Atlas">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30387023|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2009-08-28|time=11:05 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180225165344/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-109}}</ref>
